capabilities: insert a configurable HTML select into a note via the command palette
configure the select's options in a modal
make select value changes permanent by updating the Markdown
open the select creation modal from a ribbon icon
extras: The README shows Markdown examples as [code example] placeholders and refers to screenshots through 'How to use' steps, but no actual usage examples are described in the text.
problem: HTML select elements in Obsidian are not persistent, so changing a value in view mode does not update the note's source.
summary: Plugin that inserts configurable HTML select elements into notes and rewrites the Markdown when the selection changes in view mode.
